notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around the standard Auto Provide callback. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, Auto Provide FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies object discovery, provideAttributeValueUpdate callback suppression, callback release after re-enable, callback-model servicing, object and attribute identity, empty user tag, Auto Provide switch state, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with standard Auto Provide object registration and FederateAmbassador provideAttributeValueUpdate delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador callback-control and Auto Provide declarations
